name: ops/execution-permit-consume-stale-fence-problem-valid
description: RT-05 stale-fence negative: a consume carrying a superseded byom_fence_epoch (or a stale meta.expected_revision intent pin) fails stale_revision — Byom atomically rechecks both current fences and the pinned intent revision before inserting MandateUse (§13.1 steps 4-5; R34 dual fences, gap note G37).

problem.title: consume fence or intent revision is no longer current
problem.detail: byom_fence_epoch 4 was superseded by a lease re-claim (current epoch 5) and the intent head moved past meta.expected_revision; the one-shot decision is not consumable under stale fences — re-read the current intent head and fences before retrying
